    "Single visible label via Form Field — do not duplicate a Text Input label beside it.",
    "Associate the control with the label through Form Field controlId so naming stays native.",
    "Error state needs aria-invalid and aria-describedby; Validation Message id wires that association.",

  "implementation": "Install form-field, text-input, and validation-message via @skrewww. Compose FormField as the shell with stable controlId, label, optional supportingText/required, and error when invalid. Render TextInput as FormField children, aligning id/required/error with the shell (Form Field owns the label). When invalid, set FormField error and use ValidationMessage type=\"error\" with id (and announce as needed) so aria-describedby stays coherent. Preserve data-skrewww-shape=\"rounded\" and data-skrewww-surface=\"glass\"."
